name: ChatGPT Ads Conversions
description: Send website events from Segment to the ChatGPT Ads Conversions API.

pixel_id.label: Pixel ID
pixel_id.description: The Pixel ID for your Ads Manager data source.

api_key.label: Conversions API Key
api_key.description: A server-side CAPI key with access to this Pixel ID. Keep this key private.

reportWebEvent.title: Report Website Event
reportWebEvent.description: Send a website conversion or custom event to ChatGPT Ads through the Conversions API.

event_type.label: Event Type
event_type.description: The ChatGPT Ads website event to send. Select custom for an advertiser-defined event.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: A stable ID for this event. Reuse it on retries and in Pixel when sending the same conversion.

timestamp.label: Event Time
timestamp.description: Original event time as an ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone, or integer Unix milliseconds. Do not use the delivery time.

source_url.label: Page URL
source_url.description: The website URL where the event occurred. Credentials, query parameters and fragments are removed. Map a path without personal data.

custom_event_name.label: Custom Event Name
custom_event_name.description: Required for custom events. Use 1–64 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number.

opt_out.label: Opt Out
opt_out.description: Map the advertiser opt-out signal: true, false, or null/absent for unspecified. This does not replace consent-based routing in Segment.

oppref.label: Ad Click Reference
oppref.description: The existing OpenAI ad click reference. Pass the value unchanged.

amount.label: Value
amount.description: Event value. By default, use major currency units: 42.50 for USD 42.50. Set Amount Units to minor if the source already sends cents.

amount_units.label: Amount Units
amount_units.description: Applies to both the event value and item unit prices. Major converts using the currency; minor requires integers.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as USD. Required when Value is present.

plan_id.label: Plan ID
plan_id.description: Optional plan ID for subscription, trial, or custom events.

contents.label: Items
contents.description: Products or content for commerce, page, subscription, trial, or custom events. Item price is a unit price, not a line total.

amount.label: Unit Price
amount.description: Price per item in the selected Amount Units.

currency.label: Item Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency. Defaults to the event currency when absent.

variant_dict.label: Variants
variant_dict.description: Variant names and string values, such as color: blue.

email.label: Email
email.description: Optional raw email. The connector trims, lowercases and hashes it before sending. Do not map an already hashed value here.

external_id.label: Customer ID
external_id.description: Optional customer ID. The connector trims both ends, preserves case and hashes it before sending. Do not map an already hashed value here.

user_data.label: Matching Data
user_data.description: Optional customer matching fields. Identity hashes must be prepared upstream. Use only data permitted by your consent rules.

email_sha256.label: Email SHA-256
email_sha256.description: A lowercase, 64-character SHA-256 hash of the trimmed, lowercase email.

external_id_sha256.label: External ID SHA-256
external_id_sha256.description: A lowercase, 64-character SHA-256 hash of the customer ID, trimmed at both ends with case preserved.

ip_address.label: IP Address
ip_address.description: The customer IP address from the original event. Do not use the server IP.

user_agent.label: User Agent
user_agent.description: The customer browser user agent from the original event.

obref.label: Browser Reference
obref.description: The existing OpenAI browser reference. Pass the value unchanged.

emails_sha256.label: emails_sha256
emails_sha256.description: Up to three lowercase, 64-character SHA-256 hashes. Normalize identifiers before hashing.

external_ids_sha256.label: external_ids_sha256
external_ids_sha256.description: Up to three lowercase, 64-character SHA-256 hashes. Normalize identifiers before hashing.

phone_numbers_sha256.label: phone_numbers_sha256
phone_numbers_sha256.description: Up to three lowercase, 64-character SHA-256 hashes. Normalize identifiers before hashing.

first_names_sha256.label: first_names_sha256
first_names_sha256.description: Up to three lowercase, 64-character SHA-256 hashes. Normalize identifiers before hashing.

last_names_sha256.label: last_names_sha256
last_names_sha256.description: Up to three lowercase, 64-character SHA-256 hashes. Normalize identifiers before hashing.

countries.label: countries
countries.description: Up to three customer geographic values.

cities.label: cities
cities.description: Up to three customer geographic values.

regions.label: regions
regions.description: Up to three customer geographic values.

postal_codes.label: postal_codes
postal_codes.description: Up to three customer geographic values.

custom_properties.label: Custom Properties
custom_properties.description: Explicitly selected properties for custom events only. Do not include personal data or credentials here.
